neighbours.label: Fires on verbs and predicates that say a rule, law or principle is applicable or in force (apply, applies, hold, remain in force, gilt); quiet on the same verbs in their physical or request senses (apply paint, apply for a job, hold a cup).
fire: Special tax rules apply to income earned abroad.
The usual conservation laws still hold inside the reactor.
The same speed limit applies on rural roads at night.
These safety requirements apply equally to contractors and staff.
The theorem holds for any continuous function on a closed interval.
Old customs rules no longer apply after the treaty.
Our refund policy applies to all orders placed online.
Für Mitglieder gilt eine ermäßigte Gebühr.
quiet: Spread a layer of glue and apply the veneer to the board.
The workers still hold the heavy beams inside the shed.
The same nurse applies ointment on the ward at night.
These nurses apply bandages to contractors and staff.
The child holds a balloon in each hand at the fair.
Old customers no longer apply for loans after the move.
Our neighbor applies sunscreen before every walk.
Für Mitglieder gibt es einen kleinen Parkplatz.
